question:
Victoria Waterfalls are located in _____.

A. United States of America

B. Britain

C. France

D. Africa
solution:
The correct answer is __**Africa.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• Victoria Waterfalls is a fall located on the borders of Zambia and Zimbabwe in Africa
 
 
• Victoria Waterfalls are located in **Africa.**__
 
• It is located on the **Zambezi river.**
 
• It was named after **Queen Victoria.**
 
• It is the only waterfall in the world with a length of more than a kilometer and a height of more than a hundred meters.
 
• It was designated as a World Heritage site in** 1989.**
 
• It is a **Cataract** type waterfall.
 
 
 
• The highest waterfall is** Angel falls **of Venezuela in South America.
 
• **Niagara** falls located on the border between Canada and the USA in North America.
